newsitem.title: GERMANY: Russia eurobond issue for launch Thursday - Deutsche.
newsitem.headline: Russia eurobond issue for launch Thursday - Deutsche.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG said on Wednesday that an expected eurobond issue by Russia would be launched on Thursday, with a volume of at least 1.5 billion marks and a maturity of seven years.

Georg Krupp, the management board member responsible for Russia, told a news conference in Frankfurt, "The two lead banks Credit Suisse First Boston and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell will launch the bond issue tomorrow (Thursday) morning.
"The amount of the bond issue will be at least 1.5 billion marks," he added.
Deutsche said full terms of the issue would be announced later on Thursday.
Russia's deputy finance minister Mikhail Kasyanov, responding to a question on Russia's further Eurobond issuance plans, said: "On top of the 1.5 billion marks we expect a further $2 billion."
